description: This file defines the 'Online' controller class for the Opencart admin dashboard extension, handling online customer data display, configuration, and interactions within the dashboard interface.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Controller class for managing the online dashboard widget and its configuration in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes and displays the online dashboard configuration form, setting up data and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the online dashboard widget, with permission checks.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates and returns data about current online customers, formatted for display in the dashboard.
